video_title: Jalen Brunson undergoes surgery + Brad Stevens responds to Jaylen Brown trade criticism | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson played through a wrist injury during the championship run
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson played through this injury during the playoffs, during the Knicks' finals run this past season.
quotes.quote: Earlier today Jalen Brunson underwent surgery on his left wrist and the impressive part here is Jalen Brunson played through this injury during the playoffs, during the Knicks' finals run this past season. He is going to need a month, two months for this recovery. The expectation is that Jalen Brunson will return to full basketball activities later on in the summer, but this is his shooting wrist, his left wrist, so this is something he had to get taken care of today, had to get it cleaned up and now he is going to rehab this, recover it and should be a go later in this summer, the off season.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's toughness adds to his legacy as a Knicks player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the type of player that if he's on the floor, he's going to give his best.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is the type of player and he comes from the stock that if he's on the floor, he's going to give his best. He's not going to make any excuses and so finding out in hindsight that there was an injury that would require surgery only adds to his lore and his status as the King of New York.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brad Stevens explains the rationale behind trading Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: The path looked a little bit more challenging was 70% of our cap and such a high percent
quotes.quote: The path looked a little bit more challenging to me. I might be wrong, I'm not going to stand up here and be defensive about that, but the path looked a little bit more challenging was 70% of our cap and such a high percent of our usage tied into two players. You have to do a great job and you have to have the optionality to do a great job of building out depth that can hopefully replace the irreplaceable individual and that's not an easy thing to do.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics front office failed to explain the real case for trading Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they won any hearts and minds over why they did this.
quotes.quote: I don't think they won any hearts and minds over why they did this and I think that's because they really didn't present the real case for trading him. They did a lot of vague talk, talking about terms like optionality, like they could turn things that they acquired into other things, but I don't think that Brad wanted to totally say why he did this because it might be considered a little bit coarse and offensive because obviously Jaylen Brown is viewed as one of the great Celtics of this last generation.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics are entering a new phase with Jayson Tatum as the centerpiece
quotes.excerpt: Now it feels like this is phase two. Jaylen Brown is out, now Jayson Tatum is the centerpiece.
quotes.quote: Now it feels like this is phase two. Jaylen Brown is out, now Jayson Tatum is the centerpiece. Derek White is the only other main guy remaining and so I think the question is vision in this phase two. How are we going to compete? Because a lot of the fans see Jaylen Brown going to the 76ers and not too far away as helping the enemy in some ways.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics believe their roster can compensate for the loss of Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: They see that Hugo Gonzalez can give more, that Baylor Scheierman can give more, that Paul George can give.
quotes.quote: They look at their team and they see that Hugo Gonzalez can give more, that Baylor Scheierman can give more, that Paul George can give good production and then potentially be traded for something in the short-term future, that the draft pieces that they have can give more and that when all the dust settles, that the production that they're getting is equal to or above what Jaylen Brown brought. Peyton Pritchard I think could get a larger role. He just can't delineate that nor will he delineate that right now because it puts them in a bad spot.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's MVP-caliber play was the key to the Celtics' system
quotes.excerpt: What unlocked all of them? Being around Jaylen Brown having a top-six MVP-caliber year.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: What unlocked all of them? Being around Jaylen Brown having a top-six MVP-caliber year. That matters when you're talking about role players being able to be elite.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: He was the anomaly in the Mazzulla system that kept defenses honest because he was so good in isolation, he was so good in mid-range, he was so good in off the dribble.
